actual_scope: At the fixed port9 inverse column-1 leaf, certify an eight-step new-low commit successor and show that blanking cache bits 24..191 falsifies the leaf exit contract.
scope_change_reason: Handoff item 9 asked for an N-dimensional stock/owner/route generator after PR4957. Canonical discussion 4945 has since delivered the route, frontend, rotation and port9 leaf, and left the new-low commit and cache-retirement question open. This package answers that remaining gate instead of rebuilding the generator or auditing four-provider dispatch.
bottleneck_link: The selected BIT cap still depends on physical cache and output ownership. Closing this gate says which data this leaf may mark and which data it must still return; it does not change the signed moment or the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop after the two straight-line successors and the digit-8 preservation check. Do not implement a low-type consumer, ROW installer, whole-T layout or new kappa.
evidence: Static tape inventories for both orientations; forward and inverse witness exits; digit-8 mutant with equal owner and new-low; eight-step commit and 551-step tail retirement, each rejected by the predecessor exit equality. Receipt RESULT.json.
